supplements.title: Clinical and Molecular Perspectives on Epidermodysplasia Verruciformis.
supplements.summary: Researchers found that epidermodysplasia verruciformis, a rare skin disorder with increased skin cancer risk, has both inherited and acquired forms linked to human papillomavirus infections.

supplements.title: Bufalin Inhibits the PI3K/AKT Pathway by Targeting GTF3C4 to Impede Breast Cancer Progression.
supplements.summary: Bufalin targets GTF3C4 protein in breast cancer, inhibiting cell growth and spreading by blocking a key molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Metabolic Signature of a Healthy Lifestyle and the Risk of MASLD and Other Chronic Liver Diseases: An Observational and Mendelian Randomization Study.
supplements.summary: A healthy lifestyle metabolic signature is linked to lower risks of metabolic liver diseases, potentially offering new prevention and monitoring strategies.

supplements.title: A randomized clinical trial assessing the efficacy of vitamin B prophylaxis in attenuating paclitaxel-induced neuropathy and the imperative use of gabapentin in diabetic ovarian cancer patients.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Prophylactic vitamin B significantly reduced chemotherapy-induced nerve damage in ovarian cancer patients, potentially improving treatment outcomes and reducing the need for additional pain medication.

supplements.title: Microbiota-derived IPA protects against colitis by regulating intestinal HMGCS2-mediated ketogenesis to facilitate mucosal healing.
supplements.summary: In colitis, gut bacteria-produced IPA helps heal intestinal damage by activating stem cells and boosting tissue regeneration through a specific metabolic pathway.

supplements.title: Advances in extraction, structural characteristics, bioactivities, structure-activity relationship, quality control and applications of polysaccharides from Tremella fuciformis: A review.
supplements.summary: Tremella fuciformis polysaccharides show promising potential for health maintenance and potential cancer treatment support through their unique bioactive properties.

supplements.title: Natural inhibitors of PTP1B: Caffeic acid, cinnamic acid, and cinnamaldehyde as promising agents against triple-negative breast cancer.
supplements.summary: Caffeic acid, cinnamic acid, and cinnamaldehyde showed potential in reducing the growth of triple-negative breast cancer cells while sparing healthy cells.

supplements.title: Phytochemical Profiling and Computational Docking Studies Revealing the Potential Anticancer and Antioxidant Properties of Heliotropium indicum L.
supplements.summary: Heliotropium indicum plant extract inhibited tumor growth by 76% in an Ehrlich ascites carcinoma model, showing promising anticancer potential.

supplements.title: Covalent targeting of PSMD14 by Eupalinolide B induces oncoprotein degradation and apoptosis in acute promyelocytic leukemia cells.
supplements.summary: Eupalinolide B targets a key protein in acute promyelocytic leukemia cells, causing cancer protein breakdown and cell death.

supplements.title: Alpha-Lipoic Acid Reduces NLRP3/ASC Expression and IL-1β Release in Kupffer Cells and Improves Insulin Signaling in FL83B Hepatocytes Exposed to a Conditioned Medium.
supplements.summary: Alpha-lipoic acid reduces inflammatory markers in liver cells and improves insulin signaling, offering potential therapeutic benefits for type 2 diabetes.

supplements.title: Therapeutic Interventions to Manage Oral Mucositis and Their Impact on Quality of Life in Cancer Patients: An Umbrella Review.
supplements.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

This review examines treatments for oral mucositis in head and neck cancer patients, highlighting the complex impact of interventions on patients' quality of life.

supplements.title: The relationship between the latent profiles of cancer-related fatigue characteristics and exercise adherence in colorectal cancer patients.
supplements.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

A study identified different patterns of fatigue in colorectal cancer patients and how they relate to patients' likelihood of maintaining exercise routines.

supplements.title: Postbiotics from Lactobacillus helveticus Attenuate Enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis-Induced Inflammation and NF-κB Activation in Colorectal Epithelial Cells.
supplements.summary: Postbiotics from Lactobacillus helveticus reduced inflammation and toxin-induced damage in colorectal cells by suppressing harmful inflammatory pathways.

supplements.title: Food-grade Lacticaseibacillus paracasei postbiotics suppress oral Streptococcus mutans biofilm formation and cariogenicity.
supplements.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary in under 25 words:

Food-derived Lacticaseibacillus paracasei bacteria byproducts effectively disrupt harmful oral bacteria's ability to form dental cavity-causing biofilms.

supplements.title: Effects of Cocoa Extract and Multivitamin Supplementation on Venous Thromboembolism in the COSMOS Trial.
supplements.summary: In the COSMOS trial, cocoa extract and multivitamin supplements showed limited impact on preventing venous blood clot events among study participants.

off_label.title: Repurposing biosimilars, rethinking costs: a framework for sustainable drug pricing for repurposed bevacizumab for intravitreal injections.
off_label.summary: A novel framework suggests pricing for repurposed bevacizumab in ophthalmology ranges from €73 to €177 per injection, balancing research costs with healthcare affordability.

off_label.title: Fenofibrate potentiates the therapeutic efficacy of EZH2 inhibitors on melanoma via TRIM21- and OTUD4-mediated EZH2 ubiquitination.
off_label.summary: In melanoma, combining fenofibrate with EZH2 inhibitors improves cancer treatment by modulating fatty acid metabolism and enhancing drug effectiveness.

off_label.title: Tumor‑associated glucocorticoid inhibition by mifepristone reduces polymorphonuclear myeloid‑derived suppressor cells and promotes antitumor immunity in triple‑negative breast cancer‑bearing mice.
off_label.summary: Mifepristone reduced immune-suppressing cells and boosted immune response in triple-negative breast cancer, potentially offering a new treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Cardiovascular medications and treatment outcomes in multiple myeloma: insights from phase III clinical trials.
off_label.summary: In multiple myeloma patients, ACE inhibitors/ARBs were linked to improved progression-free survival but increased adverse event risks during treatment.

off_label.title: PTUPB improves cognitive function in Alzheimer's disease associated with enhancing cerebral vascular myogenic response and attenuating vascular remodeling.
off_label.summary: PTUPB, a dual enzyme inhibitor, improved cognitive function in Alzheimer's disease by enhancing cerebral blood vessel responses and reducing vascular remodeling.

off_label.title: ConvAHKG: Action-based hybrid knowledge graph with a dual-channel convolutional approach for drug repurposing.
off_label.summary: ConvAHKG, a novel machine learning approach, effectively predicts potential drug repurposing for non-small cell lung cancer by analyzing complex biological relationships.

off_label.title: Anticonvulsant effects of novel and repurposed drugs on docetaxel-induced neuropathy in C. elegans.
off_label.summary: Sildenafil citrate and a novel compound (RVM-3) reduced seizure-like symptoms in worms experiencing docetaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy.

off_label.title: Clinical retrospective analysis of metformin on TSH levels and nodule volume in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus combined with thyroid nodules.
off_label.summary: Metformin treatment in type 2 diabetes patients with thyroid nodules significantly reduced thyroid-stimulating hormone levels and nodule size over 12 months.

off_label.title: A Two Birds with One Stone Strategy: Sialic Acid-Modified Pitavastatin Liposomes for Combating Atherosclerosis and Tumors.
off_label.summary: Sialic acid-modified pitavastatin liposomes effectively reduced atherosclerosis progression and tumor growth by targeting neutrophils and enhancing T-cell infiltration.

off_label.title: Suppression of interferon signaling via small-molecule modulation of TFAM.
off_label.summary: Small-molecule TFAM modulators increase mitochondrial DNA stability and reduce inflammatory responses in mitochondrial dysfunction-related cellular disease models.

off_label.title: Successful Everolimus Therapy for Atrioventricular Block Due to Cardiac Rhabdomyoma Associated With Tuberous Sclerosis Complex.
off_label.summary: Everolimus effectively reduced a cardiac tumor in a tuberous sclerosis patient, resolving potentially life-threatening heart rhythm disruption caused by tumor compression.

off_label.title: Transcriptomic Correlation Identifies Cell Model Representatives for MYCN-Amplified Pediatric Neuroblastoma, Downstream Impact of Model Choice on Functional Interpretation, and Potential Drug Repositioning Candidates.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified specific neuroblastoma cell lines that closely match patient tumor gene expression, revealing potential new drug treatments for MYCN-amplified, high-risk pediatric cancer.

off_label.title: Safety of anagliptin/metformin combination tablets evaluated by non-inferiority between pre- and post-serum lactic acid levels in Japanese patients with type 2 diabetes and moderate renal impairment (AMELIO STUDY).
off_label.summary: A study found anagliptin/metformin combination tablets are safe for Japanese type 2 diabetes patients with moderate kidney problems, based on stable lactic acid levels.

off_label.title: Giant Cell Arteritis/Polymyalgia Rheumatica and Atypical Pulmonary Carcinoid Tumor: A Paraneoplastic Syndrome?
off_label.summary: A 59-year-old man with giant cell arteritis developed a rare paraneoplastic syndrome linked to a small-cell lung neuroendocrine carcinoma.

off_label.title: A novel DYRK1A inhibitor alleviates lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury via suppressing inflammatory pathway.
off_label.summary: A new drug targeting DYRK1A effectively reduces inflammation and damage in acute lung injury, potentially offering a promising treatment approach.

biomarkers.title: [Juvenile granulosa cell tumor with IDH1 gene somatic mutation: report of a case].
biomarkers.summary: A 24-year-old woman with ovarian juvenile granulosa cell tumor and IDH1 gene mutation was found to have concurrent Ollier disease during surgical investigation.

biomarkers.title: [Ectopic liver: a clinicopathological analysis of four cases].
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

A rare case study of four ectopic liver tissue occurrences, highlighting the developmental anomaly and potential tumor risk requiring careful surgical evaluation.

biomarkers.title: [Metastatic Ewing's sarcoma in serous effusions: a clinicopathological analysis of three cases].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers analyzed three pediatric Ewing's sarcoma cases in serous effusions, identifying key diagnostic markers like CD99 and EWSR1 gene rearrangement.

biomarkers.title: [HER2 protein expression and gene status in endometrial serous carcinoma].
biomarkers.summary: In uterine serous carcinoma, HER2 protein expression is heterogeneous, with gene amplification observed across different immunohistochemistry staining levels.

biomarkers.title: [Clinicopathological and molecular characteristics of extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma: an analysis of sixteen cases].
biomarkers.summary: A rare soft tissue cancer called extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma was characterized by unique genetic rearrangements in NR4A3 gene and distinct cellular patterns.

biomarkers.title: [Multifocal EBV-associated smooth muscle tumors: a clinicopathological analysis of seven cases].
biomarkers.summary: In immunocompromised children and young adults, multifocal Epstein-Barr virus-associated smooth muscle tumors can spread to multiple organs with varying clinical outcomes.

biomarkers.title: [Clinicopathological characteristics of anaplastic sarcoma of the kidney in children].
biomarkers.summary: In children, anaplastic sarcoma of the kidney is a rare DICER1-related tumor characterized by complex histological features and potential metastatic risk.

biomarkers.title: [YWHAE-rearranged clear cell sarcoma of kidney: a clinicopathological analysis of seven cases].
biomarkers.summary: A rare kidney cancer in children with YWHAE gene rearrangement shows morphological diversity and aggressive behavior, requiring molecular testing for accurate diagnosis.

biomarkers.title: [Clinicopathological and molecular features of acquired cystic disease-associated renal cell carcinoma].
biomarkers.summary: In patients with long-term kidney disease, acquired cystic disease-associated renal cell carcinoma typically shows unique morphological features and favorable prognosis with genetic pathway alterations.

biomarkers.title: [Homologous recombination repair gene variants in hormone-sensitive prostate cancer].
biomarkers.summary: In high-risk hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, genetic mutations in DNA repair genes like BRCA2 and CDK12 are common and associated with more aggressive disease.

biomarkers.title: [Pathological evaluation and research progress of renal cell carcinoma with tumor thrombus].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are improving understanding of how tumor thrombus forms in kidney cancer by examining molecular mechanisms and refining pathological assessment techniques.

biomarkers.title: [Tripeptide polymer-based cell-imprinted hydrogels for high-efficiency circulating tumor cell capture].
biomarkers.summary: A novel hydrogel with cell-imprinted cavities and a specific tripeptide can capture up to 94% of circulating tumor cells with high selectivity and biocompatibility.

biomarkers.title: [Preparation of superhydrophilic imprinted resin-graphene aerogel composite and its precise recognition of tumor biomarker in urine].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a novel graphene-based material that can accurately detect 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid, a biomarker for neuroendocrine tumors, in urine samples.

biomarkers.title: [Design and synthesis of molecularly imprinted polymers and their applications in medical diagnosis and biocatalysis].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed advanced synthetic polymers that can detect cancer cells with unprecedented sensitivity, enabling potential early diagnosis and targeted treatment.

biomarkers.title: Multi-attribute methods in antibody-drug conjugate characterization and quality control: Opportunities, challenges, and regulatory outlook.
biomarkers.summary: Multi-attribute mass spectrometry methods enable comprehensive characterization of antibody-drug conjugates, providing detailed insights into their complex structural properties and modifications.

trials.title: Simple and high-efficiency extraction and analysis of exosomes from body fluids using zirconium (IV)-immobilized restricted-access adsorbent.
trials.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Researchers developed a new method to efficiently extract exosomes from body fluids, successfully identifying 227 upregulated and 102 downregulated proteins in prostate cancer patients.
